text:
Maria: Quick sync — prepping the microfunnel assets for the benchmark launch. Need 3 quick decisions: pick 2 hero charts, 1 sales enable chart, and CTA routing copy. Goal = unambiguous latency vs cost story for demo + webinar.

Alex: My vote: (1) P50/P95 latency distribution (line + shaded percentiles) and (2) cost per 1k tokens by model (bar). Simple, no clutter.

Jon: +1. Also show a tiny inset for tail latency (99th) — customers care about spikes.

Casey: For the sales slide, recommend a microfunnel diagram that maps 'fastpath (hosted)' vs 'economy (dedicated/quantized)' with expected $/token bands.

Pritam: For inbound routing: self-serve CTA for SMB (hosted trial), 'Request Dedicated' for mid-market, and 'Contact sales / private deployment' for enterprise. Add UTMs.

Alex: Quick data sketch for charting (CSV):
```
model,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k
rw-3b,45,120,300,0.20
rw-34b,80,240,600,0.75
rw-70b,120,380,1200,1.20
```
Use log-scale on cost axis if needed.

Maria: Nice. For hero copy options (short):
- "Predictable latency. Clear unit economics."
- "High-performance inference, lower token cost."
Pick one.

Jon: Prefer #1 — it signals reliability + econ.

Casey: Also add visual showing batching/cache impact: example callout "up to 50% cheaper on steady workloads" with a small before/after bar.

Alex: I can mock the two hero PNGs and the batching inset by EOD. Will include alt text and a 25–30 char hero line.

LaunchBot: Figma: microfunnel-v3 uploaded by Maria — https://figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/microfunnel-v3 (permissions: marketing edit).

Pritam: UTM pattern suggestion: `?utm_campaign=bench-launch&utm_source=marketing&utm_medium=web` and add `utm_content=hero` for hero assets.

Maria: Perfect. Action list: Alex -> charts + PNGs EOD; Casey -> funnel copy + routing snippet; Jon -> webinar format (20m talk + 25m Q); Pritam -> UTM + tracking setup. I'll stitch slides and send draft for review tomorrow morning.

Alex: On it. Quick question — do we want raw numbers on the hero or only relative bars?

Maria: Raw numbers for sales slide, relative + callouts on hero (keep hero concise).

Jon: Webinar CTA: include a small demo sign-up flow and a 'Bring your prompt' slot so attendees can test.

Casey: Routing copy draft: "Start on Redwood Hosted for immediate results — scale to Dedicated or Private for predictable throughput and compliance."

Maria: Love it. Thanks team — will loop back with a slide deck link. :thumbsup:
